notes: T13D1 (Trainer Build + Visual Identity Corrective REPLAN): source-backed facts for guided level-1 creation and advancement that were previously only free text. Every field below is traceable to a page cited in T13D_TRAINER_BUILD_REPLAN.md's normative source-to-behavior table, itself verified line-by-line against the Core PDF by Claude Code Revisor (T13D_PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVE_v2.md). This dataset does not implement rule evaluation (that is T13D3/T13D4); it freezes the facts a future evaluator reads. `trainer_progression.json` and `trainer_milestones.json` remain the source of truth for per-level totals and milestone level/choice-option strings; this dataset only adds structure those two files intentionally left as prose.

rank_table.notes: Canonical Core rank ordinal, 1-6, dice = ordinal. `seed/json/edges.json` and `seed/json/features.json`'s existing `prerequisite_semantics.rank_value` field uses a DIFFERENT, incorrect numbering (untrained=0, novice=2, adept=3, expert=4, master=5 — pathetic is never referenced so its seed value is unobserved) confirmed by Claude Code Revisor's independent PDF check. Any prerequisite evaluator MUST normalize through the `ranks` list below keyed by name, never by trusting the seed's raw `rank_value` integer directly.

ordinary_rank_caps_by_level.notes: Normal maximum attainable rank at each threshold level, absent a Skill Edge. Background's one Adept skill is the explicit Level 1 exception to the Novice-at-L1 cap.

background.notes: The explicit textual lock on the three lowered skills is in the Quick-Start Steps, p18 (T13D_PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVE_v2.md's MINOR finding corrected the plan's page citation; the rule itself was already correct). Custom Background name/story is allowed; nothing here is a fixed preset list.

skill_edges.notes: The eight Skill Edges named in the Core p52 subtitle. This is a closed, exhaustive list — an Edge that merely has a skill-rank prerequisite (e.g. Mystic Senses' 'Novice Intuition') is NOT a Skill Edge by that fact alone; only these eight are (T13D_PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVE_v2.md). `definition_version_id` here is the existing seed/json/edges.json entry each policy describes; no duplicate content record is created by this dataset.

entries.name: Basic Skills
entries.notes: Selects a skill and advances it one legal rank step. Repeats are independent acquisitions; two sequential Basic Skills on one skill can be legal after creation.

entries.name: Skill Enhancement
entries.notes: Selects two distinct skills for a +2 CHECK bonus each. No skill may be covered twice across all of this Trainer's Skill Enhancement acquisitions.

entries.name: Skill Stunt
entries.notes: Conditional -1 die/+6 option under a distinct GM-approved circumstance — never an always-on rank bonus.

entries.name: Virtuoso
entries.notes: Effective Rank 8 applies only to qualifying EFFECTS, never to the check's rolled dice (explicitly not '8d6').

elemental_connection.notes: Core p56 states no repetition; the plan's own source-fidelity review confirms the Core text is silent on repeatability, unlike the eight Skill Edges' explicit repeat rules above. Distinct-type repetition is therefore never treated as official Core in this dataset — it exists only as an explicitly labeled, opt-in campaign variant, matching the user's 2026-09-05 request.

core.label: Core (official)
core.notes: A second Elemental Connection acquisition of any type is rejected outright, regardless of type.

campaign_variant_distinct_type.label: Campaign variant: distinct Elemental Types (user request, 2026-09-05)
campaign_variant_distinct_type.notes: Permits e.g. Fire + Water; rejects a second acquisition of the same type (e.g. Fire + Fire). Must be visibly attributed as a campaign variant wherever shown, never presented as Core.

parameter_aware_prerequisite_examples.notes: Basic Psionics requires the Psychic-typed Elemental Connection instance specifically, not any instance of the Edge.

level_bonus_skill_edge.notes: At each listed level the Trainer gains one ADDITIONAL restricted Skill Edge that cannot itself attain the rank newly unlocked at that same level (e.g. the Level 2 bonus Skill Edge cannot Rank Up a skill to Adept). `trainer_progression.json`'s `edges_at_level` for levels 2/6/12 (value 2) ALREADY includes this bonus alongside the one ordinary Edge granted at those levels — a consumer must split that pool into 1 ordinary + 1 restricted, never add the restricted pick as a further +1 on top of the existing total.

training_features.notes: The four free Training Features (one chosen without checking its own prerequisites, as part of creation's 4 paid Edges + 4 paid Features + 1 free Training Feature budget). Normal (non-free) selections still check prerequisites as usual.

creation_budget.notes: Steps 3-4 (edges/features) may alternate in either order. Steps 8-9 (starter/starting items) are GM decisions (Core p17), never a fabricated default — see `build_state`'s `campaign_setup_pending` in the API contract.

offensive_stat_streams.notes: The Trainer Progression Chart's finite Attack/Special Attack bonus Stat Point streams. Each is a per-choice alternative to the listed non-stream options at that milestone level; none of these replace the normal +1 Stat Point granted every level regardless. `qualifies` fields describe an eligibility category only (e.g. 'general_feature') — resolving which specific Features/Edges qualify is T13D3/T13D4 scope, not this dataset.
